subject: [RFC PATCH 57/57] MAINTAINERS: add an entry for collapse

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a new entry to the MAINTAINERS file for the 'collapse' feature, which is now its own body of code in mm/collapse.c. The entry includes information about the maintainers and their contact details, as well as the files associated with this feature. The patch also moves related files out of the THP (Transparent Huge Pages) entry and updates the selftests to match the new location of these files.
